en.headline: Mark Six campaign could raise next Tuesday snowball jackpot to HK$80 million
en.dek: The Jockey Club said the Hype Up. Jackpot Up. scheme for the lottery’s 50th anniversary will add a larger snowball if turnover reaches HK$70 million by Monday.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club has launched a new “Hype Up. Jackpot Up.” campaign for Mark Six to mark the lottery’s 50th anniversary. Under the scheme, the size of the snowball for the Lucky Tuesday Snowball draw on 24 November will increase according to accumulated betting turnover.

The Club said that if turnover reaches HK$70 million or more by 2 pm on Monday 23 November, it will add a HK$60 million snowball, lifting the estimated First Division Prize Fund to as much as HK$80 million for a single HK$10 winning unit. Lower turnover thresholds will unlock smaller snowballs of HK$50 million or HK$55 million.

Ticket sales for the 24 November draw will begin after Thursday night’s regular draw and close at 9.15 pm on the day of the draw. The Club described the arrangement as part of its anniversary celebrations. The draw will be broadcast live on TVB Plus.

zh.headline: 六合彩「Hype Up. Jackpot Up.」活動可將下周二雪球獎金推高至8000萬
zh.dek: 賽馬會指，為慶祝六合彩50周年推出的計劃，若周一前投注額達7000萬元，將增加較大雪球金額。
body: 香港賽馬會推出「Hype Up. Jackpot Up.」活動，以慶祝六合彩成立50周年。根據計劃，11月24日「幸運星期二雪球」的雪球金額將按累積投注額調整。
賽馬會表示，若在11月23日星期一下午2時前累積投注額達到7000萬元或以上，將注入6000萬元雪球，估計頭獎基金可高達8000萬元（以單一10元注碼計算）。較低投注額門檻則分別注入5000萬或5500萬元雪球。
11月24日的彩票將於周四晚上常規攪珠後開始發售，並於攪珠當日晚上9時15分截飛。賽馬會指此安排屬周年慶祝活動的一部分。攪珠將於TVB Plus現場直播。
